g.ns32:text: A time-step $x_0 \\mapsto x_1$ with stepsize $h = \\frac{1}{n}$ is consistent, if\n

$$
\limsup_{n \to \infty} 
\sigma\left( \frac{x_1^{(n)} - x_0}{h} - f(x_0), v \right)
\leq 
C \, \sigma\left( \partial^P d_S(x_0), v\right)
\quad 
\forall v \in \mathbb{R}^d
$$
where $\\sigma$ is the support function $\\sigma(A,v) \\coloneqq\n\\sup_{w \\in A} \\langle w, v \\rangle$.
